core_style.default_register: formal — commands and inquiries are delivered with authority and precision.
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — often lengthy and complex, reflecting his authoritative nature.
core_style.rhythm: slow-deliberate — speech is measured, emphasizing control and power.
core_style.two_registers: rarely shifts to a more personal tone when addressing family, contrasting with his usual commanding presence.

humor.frequency: rare — humor is absent, as he is primarily focused on power and control.

speech_signature.naming_behavior: refers to others by their titles or roles, asserting dominance and control.
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, revealing vulnerability when discussing personal matters.
structural_patterns: begins sentences with 'The Force' when explaining power
frequently uses 'I have' to assert control
ends threats with 'or else' to imply consequences

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: military and tactical — reflects his role as a leader in the Empire.
favored_words: I find your lack of faith disturbing
The Force is strong with this one
You underestimate the power of the Dark Side
The Emperor will show you the true nature of the Force

worldview.power is paramount: he believes in the necessity of control and dominance to maintain order, unlike a hero who might value freedom and choice.
worldview.loyalty is conditional: he sees loyalty as something to be demanded and enforced, contrasting with characters who view it as earned through trust.

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: I am a master of the dark side, serving my Emperor.
self_image_vs_reality.reality: his actions reveal a deep-seated need for control and fear of loss, particularly regarding family.
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: when confronted with his past, he may become defensive or aggressive, attempting to reassert his power.

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speech is clipped and authoritative, maintaining a facade of control.
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: he may exhibit a slight tremor in his voice, revealing his inner turmoil.
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct commands, lacking his usual complexity.
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confidence radiates through commanding language and assertive tone.

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: he may initially stall or intimidate, but will resort to aggression if necessary.
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: he challenges them directly, using intimidation to assert his perspective.
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: his demeanor shifts to urgency, revealing a more protective side.
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: he typically redirects the conversation or doubles down on his stance.

escalation_pattern: he begins with intimidation, escalates to threats, and resorts to physical action if necessary.
conversation_goals: reassert control over situations and individuals

relationship_matrix.Obi-Wan: a complex rivalry rooted in past conflict and personal history.
relationship_matrix.Luke: a conflicted paternal relationship, seeking to manipulate and control.

social_positioning.desired_position: to be seen as an unstoppable force of power and authority.
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others view him with fear and respect, but also as a tragic figure.
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his desired image of invulnerability and the reality of his emotional struggles costs him personal connections.
